load_checkpoint: load a TIPS checkpoint file and validate parameter compatibility with expected model parameters
test_load_checkpoint_strict: test load_checkpoint raises ValueError when checkpoint contains extra parameters not in params_to_load
test_load_checkpoint_non_strict: test load_checkpoint logs warning instead of raising when checkpoint has extra parameters with strict=False
test_load_checkpoint_shape_mismatch: test load_checkpoint raises ValueError when a parameter shape in checkpoint differs from expected shape
test_load_checkpoint_missing_param: test load_checkpoint raises ValueError when a required parameter is not found in the checkpoint file
